settings.title: Before the big day
settings.text: Photos, dates, interviews. A spot likes to show up right before them.
settings.fix: A thin, low-shine day patch sits close to the skin so you can get on with your day.

settings.title: The picking loop
settings.text: Hands find the spot before your brain catches up.
settings.fix: A patch gives your fingers something else to find.

settings.title: Patches that slide off
settings.text: Edges lift, patches curl, and one ends up on your pillow instead of your face.
settings.fix: The night patch is thicker and more cushioned, so it stays put while you sleep.

settings.title: Check, then swap
settings.text: A patch that has turned white has taken in as much fluid as it can hold.
settings.fix: Peel it, toss it, and add a fresh one if the spot is still there.

settings.title: Cleanse and dry
settings.text: Wash your face gently and pat dry. Patches stick best to clean, dry skin.

settings.title: Press for 10 seconds
settings.text: Place the patch over the spot and press from the center out so the edges seal.

settings.title: Leave on 6–8 hours
settings.text: Wear it for 6–8 hours, or until the patch turns white, which means it has taken in as much fluid as it can hold.

settings.title: Peel and swap
settings.text: Peel from an edge, toss it, and add a fresh patch if the spot is still there.

settings.question: What is ZLOFY Stack Pro?
settings.answer: A day and night set of drug-free hydrocolloid patches. Day patches are thin and low-shine, night patches are thicker and more cushioned. Both cover and protect surfaced spots.

settings.question: How long do I wear a patch?
settings.answer: Leave a patch on for 6–8 hours, or until it turns white. Change it sooner if the edges lift.

settings.question: Can I wear makeup over the day patch?
settings.answer: You can try it: press the patch flat, then dab a thin layer of your usual product around the edges. Avoid rubbing, which can lift the patch.

settings.question: Does it work on deep or cystic bumps?
settings.answer: No. These patches are made for surfaced spots, the kind with a visible head. They are not designed for deep, under-the-skin bumps. If a breakout is painful, large or keeps coming back, see a dermatologist.

settings.question: Is it okay for sensitive skin?
settings.answer: The patches are drug-free hydrocolloid with no active ingredients. Everyone's skin is different, so try one on a small area first. Stop using it if you notice irritation, and contact us.
